name: Weekly Retro Action Reminder
description: Every Sunday 9am, email open approved actions from the latest archived retro snapshot via Gmail.

prompts.text:
Send the weekly retrospective action reminder. Do not modify repository files.

1. Read docs/reminders/latest-email-payload.json from this repo (main branch).
2. Call Gmail send_message using fields EXACTLY from that file: to, subject, body, htmlBody. Copy the "to" array verbatim — do not substitute team names (Dev Team, QA Team) as recipients.
3. If latest-email-payload.json is missing, stop: run export:reminder + commit-latest-report first.
4. Report Gmail message id on success.
